svg.aria-label: English NAFU Collagen PLUS ingredients and nutrition information
svg.text: NAFU Collagen PLUS Quick-Charge Collagen Drink
Water; fish collagen protein; mixed berry concentrate (apple, cranberry,
strawberry, raspberry, cherry, blackcurrant, currant); sugar; apple juice
concentrate; citric acid; flavouring; PureWay-C vitamin C blend (ascorbic
acid, citrus extract, rice bran powder); Streptococcus fermentation product
(contains sodium hyaluronate); red algae powder (astaxanthin; red algae
powder, maltodextrin, silicon dioxide, egg phospholipids, L-ascorbyl palmitate
[antioxidant], vitamin E [antioxidant], rosemary extract); fish collagen
protein (contains elastin); brown rice extract (corn dextrin, rice extract);
cherry blossom extract (maltodextrin, cherry blossom extract, ascorbic acid
One sachet daily; two for enhanced use. More is not beneficial.
Keep in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight.
See date printed on pack; consume promptly after opening.
Serving size: 20 ml · Servings per pack: 20
Energy 2,000 kcal · Protein 60 g · Fat 60 g · Saturated fat 18 g
Carbohydrates 300 g · Sodium 2,000 mg · Vitamin C 100 mg
Reference values for the other added ingredients are not established.
English translation of the supplied NAFU LIFE package label.
